scientific_integrity: The exact absorption-time distribution is proved analytically; finite rational checks are additional support; novelty beyond examined literature is not an independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive representable increment in a specified interval; positive normal unbounded-exponent binary arithmetic; independent truncated-guard limited-precision stochastic rounding. Does not cover sticky-bit corrections or other limited-SR modes.
title: Exact absorption-time law for fixed-increment limited-precision stochastic summation
